title: Remaining tenant runtime and lifecycle gap closure

phases.objective: Close the remaining source-level tenant runtime gaps without Production mutation: make activation pending-task summary semantics match the authorized detail surface, add governed stale CMS grant reconciliation, bridge escalated support Resolution Cases to Operational Alerts, add bounded legacy ticket Case/Alert reconciliation, and make WordPress app-local action namespace separation explicit without creating duplicate canonical Platform Plugin actions.

e2e_journeys.actor: Authenticated tenant user or governed platform operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Tenant activation snapshot, CMS authority reconciliation, Support Ticket resolution routing/reconciliation, and WordPress registry reconciliation
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Tenant-visible summary/detail counts use the same pending-task visibility contract; stale CMS grants can be detected safely and revoked only behind explicit apply confirmation; new and legacy escalated tickets converge on a real Resolution Case plus idempotent Operational Alert evidence; and WordPress adapter read operations remain on the app-connection surface while wordpress_api remains the single canonical Platform Plugin action group.
steps: Scope pending task metrics to activation-visible tenant tasks and authorized user tasks using the canonical active status set pending, in_progress, blocked.

Load a bounded no-secret user_app_connections inventory during CMS authority reconciliation and plan revocation for active grants whose referenced connection is missing, inactive, cross-tenant, cross-user, or app-mismatched.
Require explicit APPLY_CMS_AUTHORITY_RECONCILIATION confirmation before any stale grant status mutation; never DELETE grants.
When a Support Ticket Resolution Case is ensured and escalation evidence is present, insert or refresh one deterministic support_ticket Operational Alert without notification delivery side effects.

Scan bounded open legacy tickets for a missing Resolution Case or missing escalation Alert and repair them only through the canonical ensureSupportTicketResolutionCase service behind APPLY_SUPPORT_TICKET_RESOLUTION_RECONCILIATION.

Expose a WordPress action surface contract that maps adapter read operations to app_connection_action and marks them invalid as Platform Plugin selectors, while requiring exactly one canonical wordpress_rest to wordpress_api binding.
assertions: Tenant-owned pending tasks with user_id NULL are not hidden from activation summary solely because a signed-in user exists.
Pending task summary does not count terminal/deferred rows as active by using a stale exclusion list.
CMS reconciliation reads no encrypted credential payload, token, password, or secret fields when classifying stale grants.
CMS stale grant repair is revoke-only, idempotent, dry-run by default, and confirmation-gated for apply.
Escalated support tickets produce a deterministic Operational Alert tied to the Resolution Case without provider calls, external sends, or outbox writes.

Legacy support reconciliation is bounded, dry-run by default, reuses the canonical Resolution Case service, ignores closed tickets, and requires APPLY_SUPPORT_TICKET_RESOLUTION_RECONCILIATION for writes.
wordpress_rest.validate_connection, wordpress_rest.get_current_user, and wordpress_rest.read_users are not inserted as duplicate canonical app_integration_action_bindings.
No Production migration Apply, provider call, credential payload read, external send, external write, deployment, or live tenant mutation occurs in CI.
